en: No one on my team had solved that kind of problem before, but I had once before, and that [[experience]] [[must have taught]] [[me]] [[valuable lessons about staying calm]].
key: 그 경험은 나에게 귀중한 교훈을 가르쳐 주었을 것이다.
me: No one on my team had solved that kind of problem before, but I had once before, and
easy: That experience must have taught me lessons
그 경험이 나에게 교훈을 가르쳤을 것이다(teach 가르치다).
침착함을 유지하는 것에 대한 귀중한 교훈 (stay 유지하다).
요약: 전에 비슷한 문제를 풀어 본 경험이 나에게 침착하라는 교훈을 줬을 것이다.
notes: 과거에 대한 강한 추측 = must have p.p. (must + 과거형 ✕)

en: The office's Internet should be connected normally now, as the repairs have been completed, and [[employees]] [[are looking forward to being informed]] about any updates soon.
key: 직원들은 곧 소식을 안내받기를 기대하고 있다.
me: The office's Internet should be connected normally now, as the repairs have been completed, and
are looking forward to being informed
easy: Employees are looking forward to being informed
직원들은 안내받기를 기대하고 있다(look forward to 기대하다, inform 알리다).
요약: 수리가 끝나서, 직원들은 새 소식을 곧 안내받기를 기대한다.
notes: look forward to + 동명사: 직원이 '안내받는' 쪽이면 being p.p. (informing ✕ → being informed ○)

en: In addition, Tristram Stuart, an anti-waste campaigner, insists that many stores are throwing away a lot of food in good condition just to emphasize freshness, and [[he]] [[proposed]] [[that supermarkets adopt clearer labeling to reduce this waste]].
key: 그는 슈퍼마켓이 더 분명한 표시를 도입하라고 제안했다.
me: In addition, Tristram Stuart, an anti-waste campaigner, insists that many stores are throwing away a lot of food in good condition just to emphasize freshness, and
that supermarkets adopt clearer labeling to reduce this waste.
easy: 슈퍼마켓이 더 분명한 표시를 도입하라고 (adopt 도입하다).
요약: 그는 낭비를 줄이려고 슈퍼마켓이 더 분명한 표시를 쓰자고 제안했다.
notes: 제안·주장·요구·명령·권고 동사 + that절 → (should) + 동사원형 (s를 안 붙인다) (adopts ✕ → adopt ○)
앞의 insists 뒤 that절은 사실을 말하는 것이라 are throwing처럼 일반 시제

en: [[Fewer people]] [[may have visited]] [[the previous events]] because tickets were more expensive then, a trend that organizers hope will continue into next year.
key: 더 적은 사람들이 이전 행사를 방문했을지도 모른다.
me: because tickets were more expensive then,
a trend that organizers hope will continue into next year.
easy: Fewer people may have visited the events
더 적은 사람들이 행사를 방문했을지도 모른다(visit 방문하다).
because tickets were more expensive then
a trend that organizers hope will continue
주최 측이 계속되기를 바라는 경향 (continue 계속되다).
요약: 표가 비싸서 이전엔 방문객이 적었는데, 주최 측은 이 경향이 내년에도 이어지길 바란다.
notes: 앞 명사를 꾸미는 관계대명사 = that/which, what은 앞에 명사를 두지 않는다 (a trend that ○, a trend what ✕)
what = the thing that (명사 없이 혼자 '~하는 것')

en: Owls are known for their cute looks, but when they do hunt, they turn into really scary predators, and other [[birds of prey]] [[do]] too, according to wildlife researchers.
key: 다른 맹금류도 그렇게 한다(무서운 포식자로 변한다).
me: Owls are known for their cute looks, but when they do hunt, they turn into really scary predators, and
easy: Other birds of prey do too
do too (= turn into scary predators)
앞의 turn into(~로 변하다, turn)를 대신한 말.
요약: 부엉이는 귀여워도 사냥할 땐 무서워지고, 다른 맹금류도 마찬가지다.
notes: turn into처럼 두 단어짜리 동사도 일반동사 → do

en: If a person buys a shirt, he does really feel like he saved money at the cash register, and [[he]] [[did believe]] [[he made a smart choice at first]].
key: 그는 처음에 자신이 현명한 선택을 했다고 정말 믿었다.
me: If a person buys a shirt, he does really feel like he saved money at the cash register, and
he made a smart choice at first.
easy: He did believe he made a choice
그는 선택을 했다고 정말 믿었다(believe 믿다, make 하다).
요약: 셔츠를 사면 처음엔 돈을 아낀 현명한 선택이라고 진짜로 믿는다.
